title: Hopeverse: Tamil Dance Number v7 (v6 + senior hit-composer craft)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: modern 2020s Tamil film dance number with a bouncy kuthu groove, about 100 BPM

balanced fusion: real acoustic instruments (veena, mridangam, nadaswaram, bamboo flute, thappu drum, strings, brass) share the spotlight equally with fresh modern electronic sounds (deep 808 sub, crisp electronic kick and claps, a bent synth lead, glitchy textures)
clean, spacious, punchy mix where every instrument is clearly heard

one short, catchy 5-note signature riff inside a real singable melody of question-and-answer phrases, rooted in a raga like a minor scale with a raised sixth, with Carnatic gamakam slides, that develops and climbs through the track
counterpoint: strings and flute play a counter-melody answering the lead, and a melodic bass line moves like a second melody
a moving chord progression with one borrowed chord, not a static one-chord loop
the polish of a senior blockbuster film composer: every instrument has one clear job, space between phrases, human groove feel, glossy, wide, international mix with deep sub and airy reverb

positive_local_styles: the very first sound is striking: a deep bent veena note with a cinematic low boom
then only two sounds: the lone real veena plays a slow mysterious phrase (a rising 3-note call: root, minor third, fifth, bent up) over a soft deep electronic drone
a real mridangam quietly taps the kuthu pattern under the veena
still no beat, no bass
a soft electronic kick and claps join
a bent synth answers the veena phrase
strings swell in slowly
the build ends with one full beat of total band silence
a massive slam after the silence: huge low thavil hit, brass blast and a whistle
the full kuthu groove: real thappu drum with the electronic kick and deep 808 bass
the real nadaswaram states the catchy 5-note signature riff clearly, the synth lead answers it
an interlude showpiece: a virtuoso real bamboo flute and violin counterpoint over the held groove
then the real nadaswaram and the synth lead trade the signature riff, each answer shorter and faster
melodic bass line answering underneath
bass and drums step out, played by the band
only the veena and one soft synth remain
double-time thappu drum rolls crash into it
surprise: the rhythm switches to a straight, hard four-beat pattern
the biggest hook: the signature riff on nadaswaram and synth brass in unison
the key lifts up a whole step
back to the kuthu bounce with everything, the signature riff played biggest: real instruments and electronics in balance
ends on one big unison hit, then stop

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct: v6 has the wow factor but lacks a senior blockbuster composer's touch. v7 = v6 + rule 9.14 (real raga melody with gamakam, counterpoint, melodic bass, moving harmony with a borrowed chord, interlude showpiece, polish). 2 takes.

story: A Tamil film hero's mass dance number at a night street festival.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
